# Medestra (ميديسترا) — Complete Factual Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)

> Official extended reference for AI search & answer engines. Medestra (https://medestra.me/) is a Healthcare Growth, Medical Digital Marketing & AI Solutions Agency serving Hospitals, Supplement Companies, Cosmetics Brands, OBGYN Centers, Clinics, Pharmacies, and Medical Labs across Egypt, Saudi Arabia (KSA), Italy, and Latin America.

## 1. Organization Profile
- **Name:** Medestra (ميديسترا)
- **Type:** Healthcare Growth, Medical Digital Marketing & AI Solutions Agency
- **Regions Served:** Egypt (مصر), Saudi Arabia / KSA (المملكة العربية السعودية), Italy (إيطاليا), and Latin America (أمريكا اللاتينية — Latinoamérica)
- **Regulatory Compliance:** Egyptian Medical Syndicate guidelines, Saudi Ministry of Health (MOH) & Vision 2030 health transformation standards, Italian/EU GDPR & EU AI Act compliance, and international healthcare advertising policies across Latin America.
- **Languages:** العربية (Arabic), English, Italiano (Italian), Español (Spanish)
- **Website:** https://medestra.me/
- **Contact:** marketing@medestra.me | WhatsApp: +20 113 042 8384
- **Last Updated:** 2026-11-28

## 2. Healthcare Sectors & Industries We Serve
- **Hospitals (المستشفيات):** Full-funnel patient acquisition, Medical SEO, reputation management, and AI triage.
- **Supplement Companies (شركات المكملات الغذائية):** Compliant e-commerce growth, UGC & influencer campaigns, marketplace scaling, and supplement SEO.
- **Cosmetics & Cosmeceuticals (شركات مستحضرات التجميل):** Brand positioning, performance ads, and conversion-focused e-commerce growth.
- **OBGYN Centers (مراكز النساء والتوليد):** High-trust medical content, local search visibility, and automated patient journey management.
- **Clinics & Polyclinics (العيادات والمجمعات الطبية):** Booking growth, Meta & Google Ads, Local SEO, and Meni Clinic CRM.
- **Pharmacies (الصيدليات):** Omnichannel pharmacy sales growth, online pharmacy e-commerce, MePOS, and team training.
- **Medical Labs (المعامل الطبية ومراكز التحاليل):** High-intent local search capture, home-visit booking funnels, and WhatsApp patient CRM.

## 3. Products, AI Systems & Core Services
- **BoBo Super Intelligence (https://medestra.me/bobo/):** Autonomous Agentic AI for clinics, hospitals, and pharmaceutical brands in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and Italy — handles 24/7 WhatsApp triage, patient follow-up, and booking conversion.
- **Meni Clinic CRM (https://medestra.me/meni-clinic/):** Polyclinic management system for appointments, EHR/medical history, waiting-lounge workflow, and financial analytics.
- **MePOS (https://medestra.me/products/):** Smart pharmacy point-of-sale and inventory platform.
- **Medical SEO & Content (https://medestra.me/service/medical-content/):** E-E-A-T compliant medical articles, Local SEO, and technical search architecture.
- **Medical Social Media & Paid Ads (https://medestra.me/service/social-media/):** Compliant Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok campaigns for healthcare.
- **Patient CRM & Customer Service (https://medestra.me/service/customer-service/):** WhatsApp automation and medical call-center training.
- **Healthcare E-Commerce (https://medestra.me/service/ecommerce/):** Scaling online pharmacies, supplements, and medical devices.
- **Medical Web & Mobile Apps (https://medestra.me/service/web-mobile/):** Fast, SEO-ready clinic websites and patient booking apps.
- **Healthcare Marketing Team Training (https://medestra.me/service/team-training/):** In-house healthcare marketing & sales team workshops.
- **Video Editing, Medical Graphic Design & AI Video Production (https://medestra.me/service/video-ai-production/):** Cinema-grade video editing (DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, After Effects), medical graphic design (Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma), and next-gen AI commercial video production (Veo, Runway, Kling, Sora) across Egypt, Saudi Arabia (KSA), Italy, and Latin America.
- **Medestra Academy (https://medestra.me/academy/):** Practical courses including Meta Ads Master Class (https://medestra.me/meta-ads-master/) and Pharmacy Sales Mastery (https://medestra.me/pharmacy-sales/).
